rule: SMALL-CHANGE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-26): "Changing 3,000 plus files is almost unbelievable and totally unsustainable ... you have to be able to maintain everything that you create." A change is small enough to verify and revert alone. Session scratch never enters a repository.
split_hint: Split by module: one PR per package, adapter, tenant or spec section. Keep the whole on an archive/ branch if it must be preserved.
